notes:
- The real `next dev` boot output (banner + Local/Network URLs +
  `✓ Ready in …`) was captured but is too clean to exercise the
  HMR-dedup + 32-line cap behavior. Fixture is augmented with synthetic
  `Compiling /page` repeats and 50× `[hot reload] /page` lines per the
  documented Next.js 14.x dev-server output, plus a few `[hot reload]
  /about` lines to verify the hard cap (NOT per-path) at 32.
